paragraphs.text:
Powerful hairy hands clamp on your shoulders, snatching you 
from your feet. Foul-smelling hulking bodies close in, biting 
and clubbing with fists and pieces of wood.
Take 1D10 damage. If you survive the assault, go to 347.
